  rfl

  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := L_limbs

  unfold _root_.L
  rfl

/-- Arithmetic of one wrapping-subtraction step of `sub_loop`: for `x, y` small enough,
`w = x - y (mod 2^64)` has its top bit set exactly when `x < y`, and the low 52 bits of `w`
equal `x - y + 2^52 * (w >>> 63)`. -/
theorem sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `sub_loop`. -/
theorem sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

/-- Arithmetic of one wrapping-subtraction step of `sub_loop`: for `x, y` small enough,
`w = x - y (mod 2^64)` has its top bit set exactly when `x < y`, and the low 52 bits of `w`
equal `x - y + 2^52 * (w >>> 63)`. -/
theorem sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `sub_loop`. -/
theorem sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

/-- OR-ing a value `b < 2^8` shifted by `n` (with `n + 8 ≤ 64`, truncated mod `2^64`) into an
accumulator `acc < 2^n` is the same as adding `2^n * b`. Used for byte-packing loops. -/
theorem Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8)
    (hn : n + 8 ≤ 64) : acc ||| (b <<< n % 2 ^ 64) = acc + 2 ^ n * b := by

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow

theorem Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8)
    (hn : n + 8 ≤ 64) : acc ||| (b <<< n % 2 ^ 64) = acc + 2 ^ n * b := by
  have hlt : b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 64 := by
    calc b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 8 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb (Nat.two_pow_pos n)
      _ = 2 ^ (8 + n) := (Nat.pow_add 2 8 n).symm
      _ ≤ 2 ^ 64 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.or_comm, Nat.mul_comm,
    ← Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt hacc]
  omega

theorem Nat.add_two_pow_mul_lt {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8) :
    acc + 2 ^ n * b < 2 ^ (n + 8) := by
  have : 2 ^ n * b ≤ 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  rw [Nat.pow_add]
  have h2 : 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) + 2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]; have : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by decide); omega

(shifted right by `k`, with `k + m = 64`) with `b` shifted left by `m` (truncated mod `2^64`)

    (a >>> k ||| (b <<< m % 2 ^ 64)) &&& (2 ^ 52 - 1) = a / 2 ^ k + 2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ (52 - m)) := by
  have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ 64 = 2 ^ m * 2 ^ k := by rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hlo : a / 2 ^ k < 2 ^ m := by

  have hshl : b <<< m % 2 ^ 64 = 2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ k) := by
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hpow, Nat.mul_comm b, Nat.mul_mod_mul_left]

    rw [Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlo]

    Nat.add_comm]

/-- Little-endian value of nine 52-bit-radix `u128` limbs (e.g. the unreduced product of two
`Scalar52`s fed to `montgomery_reduce`). -/
def U128x9_as_Nat (limbs : Array U128 9#usize) : Nat :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 9, 2 ^ (52 * i) * (limbs[i]!).val

/-- Expansion of `U128x9_as_Nat` into its nine limbs. -/
theorem U128x9_as_Nat_expand (limbs : Array U128 9#usize) :
    U128x9_as_Nat limbs = (limbs.val[0]!).val + 2 ^ 52 * (limbs.val[1]!).val +
      2 ^ 104 * (limbs.val[2]!).val + 2 ^ 156 * (limbs.val[3]!).val +
      2 ^ 208 * (limbs.val[4]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (limbs.val[5]!).val +
      2 ^ 312 * (limbs.val[6]!).val + 2 ^ 364 * (limbs.val[7]!).val +
      2 ^ 416 * (limbs.val[8]!).val := by
  unfold U128x9_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  ring_nf

/-- Expansion of `Scalar52_as_Nat` of an explicitly built five-limb array. -/
theorem Scalar52_as_Nat_make (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : U64) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat (Array.make 5#usize [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4]) =
      r0.val + 2 ^ 52 * r1.val + 2 ^ 104 * r2.val + 2 ^ 156 * r3.val + 2 ^ 208 * r4.val := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, Array.make]
  simp only [List.getElem!_cons_zero, List.getElem!_cons_succ]
  ring_nf

    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

/-- Arithmetic heart of one iteration of `conditional_add_l_loop`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- `conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i` adds (if `condition` is set) the
limbs `i..4` of `L` to the limbs `i..4` of `self`, propagating the carry and reducing
every limb modulo `2^52`. Started at `i = 0` with `carry = 0`, the result satisfies
`r.2 + 2^260 * (r.1 / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with conditional_add_l_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact conditional_add_l_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- Splitting the conditional-addend sum into `self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
theorem conditional_add_l_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

/-- `conditional_add_l self condition` returns `(carry, r)` where every limb of `r` is
below `2^52` and `r + 2^260 * (carry / 2^52) = self + (condition ? L : 0)`. -/
@[progress]
theorem conditional_add_l_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with conditional_add_l_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := conditional_add_l_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hd j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : ((r.1.val[i.val]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i.val]!).val -
          ((b.val[i.val]!).val + ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int)) +
          2 ^ 52 * ((w.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v, hwmod, hi4, ← hi1', ← hi2', hi3v]
        push_cast; ring
      exact sub_loop_post a b r.1 i.val _ _ _ hilt hri hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hd, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]

decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- A scalar with all five limbs below `2^52` is below `2^260`. -/
theorem sub_as_Nat_lt (a : Scalar52) (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat a < 2 ^ 260 := by
  have h0 := ha 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := ha 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := ha 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := ha 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := ha 4 (by omega)
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  omega

/-- The signed limb-difference sum over `Ico 0 5` is `a - b`. -/
theorem sub_Ico_sum_sub (a b : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]
  push_cast
  ring

/-- Arithmetic combining the outcome of `sub_loop` and `conditional_add_l` in `sub`. -/
theorem sub_final_arith (A B D R f q : Nat) (hf : f ≤ 1) (hD : D < 2 ^ 260) (hR : R < 2 ^ 260)
    (hBA : B ≤ A + _root_.L)
    (hloop : (D : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * f = (A : Int) - B)
    (hadd : R + 2 ^ 260 * q = D + (if f = 1 then _root_.L else 0)) :
    R + B = A + (if A < B then _root_.L else 0) := by
  have hL : _root_.L < 2 ^ 260 := by unfold _root_.L; norm_num
  have h260 : (2 : Nat) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  have h260' : (2 : Int) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  rw [h260'] at hloop
  rw [h260] at hD hR hadd hL
  generalize _root_.L = L at *
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hf with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : ¬ A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_false]
    omega
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_true]
    omega

/-- Local spec of `Choice::from(u8)` on a bit. -/
theorem sub_choice_from_spec (x : U8) (h : x.val ≤ 1) :
    subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from x ⦃ c => c.val = x ⦄ := by
  unfold subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from
  split
  · simp
  · split
    · simp
    · exfalso
      rename_i h1 h2
      have : x.val = 0 ∨ x.val = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h3 | h3
      · exact h1 (by scalar_tac)
      · exact h2 (by scalar_tac)

/-- `sub a b` computes `a - b` modulo `L`: for limbs below `2^52` and `b ≤ a + L`, the result has
limbs below `2^52` and `r + b = a + (a < b ? L : 0)`. In particular `r ≡ a + L - b [MOD L]`,
and `r < L` whenever `a < b + L`. -/
@[progress]
theorem sub_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L) :
    sub a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r + Scalar52_as_Nat b =
        Scalar52_as_Nat a + (if Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b then _root_.L else 0) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r ≡ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L - Scalar52_as_Nat b [MOD _root_.L] ∧
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b + _root_.L → Scalar52_as_Nat r < _root_.L) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
  have hz : ∀ j, j < 5 → (ZERO.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
    intro j _; rw [ZERO_val_getElem!]; simp
  progress with sub_loop_spec as ⟨d, _, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩
  progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
  progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
  have hi1v : i1.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi1, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hi2v : i2.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by
    rw [← hi1v, hi2, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; simp; omega
  progress with sub_choice_from_spec as ⟨c, hc⟩
  progress with conditional_add_l_spec as ⟨res, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
  have hcond : (c.val = 1#u8) ↔ d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 := by
    rw [hc]; constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hi2v, h]; rfl
    · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; rw [hi2v, h]; rfl
  have hD := sub_as_Nat_lt d.1 hd2
  have hR := sub_as_Nat_lt res.2 hr1
  have hloop : (Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * ((d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
    rw [← sub_Ico_sum_sub, ← conditional_add_l_Ico_sum_eq d.1]
    simpa using hd4
  have hadd : Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (res.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 + (if d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 then _root_.L else 0) := by
    rw [hr3]; simp only [hcond]
  have heq := sub_final_arith _ _ _ _ _ _ hd3 hD hR hab hloop hadd
  refine ⟨hr1, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · split at heq
    · have : Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 = Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by omega
      rw [this]
    · have : Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L - Scalar52_as_Nat b =
          Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 + _root_.L := by omega
      rw [this, Nat.ModEq, Nat.add_mod_right]
  · intro h; split at heq <;> omega

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

import Curve25519Dalek.Funs
import Curve25519Dalek.Math.Basic

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result Aeneas.Std.WP
open curve25519_dalek

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-- The underlying list of `ZERO` is five zero limbs. -/
theorem ZERO_val : ZERO.val = List.replicate 5 0#u64 := by
  unfold ZERO
  simp [Array.repeat]

/-- Every limb of `ZERO` is zero (list indexing form). -/
theorem ZERO_val_getElem! (i : Nat) : ZERO.val[i]! = 0#u64 := by
  rw [ZERO_val]
  by_cases hi : i < 5
  · interval_cases i <;> rfl
  · rw [getElem!_neg _ _ (by simpa using hi)]; rfl

/-- Every limb of `ZERO` is zero (array indexing form). -/
@[simp]
theorem ZERO_getElem! (i : Nat) : ZERO[i]! = 0#u64 := by
  rw [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, ZERO_val_getElem!]

/-- Every limb of `ZERO` has value `0`. -/
theorem ZERO_index_val (i : Nat) : (ZERO[i]!).val = 0 := by
  rw [ZERO_getElem!]; rfl

/-- All limbs of `ZERO` are bounded by `2^52`. -/
theorem ZERO_bounds : ∀ i < 5, ZERO[i]!.val < 2 ^ 52 := by
  intro i _; rw [ZERO_index_val]; norm_num

/-- `ZERO` represents the natural number `0`. -/
@[simp]
theorem ZERO_spec : Scalar52_as_Nat ZERO = 0 := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [ZERO_index_val, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52

/-! ## Local specification of `sub`

`Sub.lean` (via `ConditionalAddL.lean`) imports this module, so the specifications of `sub`
and `conditional_add_l` are re-established here under `mr_`-prefixed names. -/

set_option exponentiation.threshold 260

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce

theorem mr_sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

theorem mr_sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

/-- Local copy of `sub_loop_spec`. -/
theorem mr_sub_loop_spec (a b difference : Scalar52) (mask borrow : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hd : ∀ j, j < 5 → (difference.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    sub_loop a b difference mask borrow i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.1.val[j]! = difference.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.1.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.1.val[j]!).val -
          2 ^ 260 * ((r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) *
          (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨i1, hi1, hi1'⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2, hi2'⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3⟩
    have hi3v : i3.val = borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi3, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi3lt : i3.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi3v]; scalar_tac
    have hai : i1.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi1']; exact ha i.val hilt
    have hbi : i2.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi2']; exact hb i.val hilt
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨w, hw⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hwv : w.val = (i1.val + (2 ^ 64 - i4.val)) % 2 ^ 64 := by
      rw [hw]; simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]
    obtain ⟨hwlt, hwmod⟩ := mr_sub_loop_step_arith i1.val i4.val w.val hai (by omega) hwv
    have hi5v : i5.val = w.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = difference.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hd j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : ((r.1.val[i.val]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i.val]!).val -
          ((b.val[i.val]!).val + ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int)) +
          2 ^ 52 * ((w.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v, hwmod, hi4, ← hi1', ← hi2', hi3v]
        push_cast; ring
      exact mr_sub_loop_post a b r.1 i.val _ _ _ hilt hri hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hd, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cal_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by

import Aeneas
import Curve25519Dalek.Math.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Digits.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset

set_option linter.style.longLine false

set_option linter.hashCommand false
#setup_aeneas_simps

open Aeneas.Std Result

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow


/-- OR-ing a value `b < 2^8` shifted by `n` (with `n + 8 ≤ 64`, truncated mod `2^64`) into an
accumulator `acc < 2^n` is the same as adding `2^n * b`. Used for byte-packing loops. -/
theorem Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8)
    (hn : n + 8 ≤ 64) : acc ||| (b <<< n % 2 ^ 64) = acc + 2 ^ n * b := by
  have hlt : b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 64 := by
    calc b * 2 ^ n < 2 ^ 8 * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb (Nat.two_pow_pos n)
      _ = 2 ^ (8 + n) := (Nat.pow_add 2 8 n).symm
      _ ≤ 2 ^ 64 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.or_comm, Nat.mul_comm,
    ← Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt hacc]
  omega

/-- Bound companion of `Nat.or_shiftLeft_mod_eq_add`. -/
theorem Nat.add_two_pow_mul_lt {acc b n : ℕ} (hacc : acc < 2 ^ n) (hb : b < 2 ^ 8) :
    acc + 2 ^ n * b < 2 ^ (n + 8) := by
  have : 2 ^ n * b ≤ 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  rw [Nat.pow_add]
  have h2 : 2 ^ n * (2 ^ 8 - 1) + 2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]; have : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ 8 := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by decide); omega
  omega

/-- Limb repacking from 64-bit words into 52-bit limbs: combining the high `m` bits of `a`
(shifted right by `k`, with `k + m = 64`) with `b` shifted left by `m` (truncated mod `2^64`)
and masking to 52 bits yields `a / 2^k + 2^m * (b % 2^(52 - m))`. -/
theorem Nat.shr_or_shl_mask52 {a b k m : ℕ} (ha : a < 2 ^ 64) (hkm : k + m = 64)
    (hm : m ≤ 52) :
    (a >>> k ||| (b <<< m % 2 ^ 64)) &&& (2 ^ 52 - 1) = a / 2 ^ k + 2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ (52 - m)) := by
  have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ 64 = 2 ^ m * 2 ^ k := by rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hlo : a / 2 ^ k < 2 ^ m := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.two_pow_pos k), ← hpow]; exact ha
  have hshl : b <<< m % 2 ^ 64 = 2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ k) := by
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hpow, Nat.mul_comm b, Nat.mul_mod_mul_left]
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, hshl, Nat.or_comm, ← Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt hlo,
    Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
  have h52 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 52 = 2 ^ m * 2 ^ (52 - m) := by rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have e1 : (2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ k) + a / 2 ^ k) % 2 ^ m = a / 2 ^ k := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlo]
  have e2 : (2 ^ m * (b % 2 ^ k) + a / 2 ^ k) / 2 ^ m = b % 2 ^ k := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos m), Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlo,
      Nat.zero_add]
  rw [h52, Nat.mod_mul, e1, e2, Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)),
    Nat.add_comm]

/-- Little-endian value of nine 52-bit-radix `u128` limbs (e.g. the unreduced product of two
`Scalar52`s fed to `montgomery_reduce`). -/
def U128x9_as_Nat (limbs : Array U128 9#usize) : Nat :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 9, 2 ^ (52 * i) * (limbs[i]!).val

/-- Expansion of `U128x9_as_Nat` into its nine limbs. -/
set_option exponentiation.threshold 500 in
theorem U128x9_as_Nat_expand (limbs : Array U128 9#usize) :
    U128x9_as_Nat limbs = (limbs.val[0]!).val + 2 ^ 52 * (limbs.val[1]!).val +
      2 ^ 104 * (limbs.val[2]!).val + 2 ^ 156 * (limbs.val[3]!).val +
      2 ^ 208 * (limbs.val[4]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (limbs.val[5]!).val +
      2 ^ 312 * (limbs.val[6]!).val + 2 ^ 364 * (limbs.val[7]!).val +
      2 ^ 416 * (limbs.val[8]!).val := by
  unfold U128x9_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  ring_nf

/-- Expansion of `Scalar52_as_Nat` of an explicitly built five-limb array. -/
theorem Scalar52_as_Nat_make (r0 r1 r2 r3 r4 : U64) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat (Array.make 5#usize [r0, r1, r2, r3, r4]) =
      r0.val + 2 ^ 52 * r1.val + 2 ^ 104 * r2.val + 2 ^ 156 * r3.val + 2 ^ 208 * r4.val := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, Array.make]
  simp only [List.getElem!_cons_zero, List.getElem!_cons_succ]
  ring_nf

all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cal_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- Local copy of `conditional_add_l_loop_spec`. -/
theorem mr_cal_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_cal_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact mr_cal_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_cal_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← mr_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp

    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj

  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]

  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx

/-- Local copy of `conditional_add_l_loop_spec`. -/
theorem mr_cal_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_cal_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact mr_cal_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_cal_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← mr_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mr_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

/-- Local copy of `conditional_add_l_spec`. -/
theorem mr_cal_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with mr_cal_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := mr_cal_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

theorem mr_as_Nat_lt (a : Scalar52) (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat a < 2 ^ 260 := by
  have h0 := ha 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := ha 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := ha 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := ha 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := ha 4 (by omega)
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  omega

theorem mr_Ico_sum_sub (a b : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem mr_sub_final_arith (A B D R f q : Nat) (hf : f ≤ 1) (hD : D < 2 ^ 260) (hR : R < 2 ^ 260)
    (hBA : B ≤ A + _root_.L)
    (hloop : (D : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * f = (A : Int) - B)
    (hadd : R + 2 ^ 260 * q = D + (if f = 1 then _root_.L else 0)) :
    R + B = A + (if A < B then _root_.L else 0) := by
  have hL : _root_.L < 2 ^ 260 := by unfold _root_.L; norm_num
  have h260 : (2 : Nat) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  have h260' : (2 : Int) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  rw [h260'] at hloop
  rw [h260] at hD hR hadd hL
  generalize _root_.L = L at *
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hf with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : ¬ A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_false]
    omega
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_true]
    omega

theorem mr_choice_from_spec (x : U8) (h : x.val ≤ 1) :
    subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from x ⦃ c => c.val = x ⦄ := by
  unfold subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from
  split
  · simp
  · split
    · simp
    · exfalso
      rename_i h1 h2
      have : x.val = 0 ∨ x.val = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h3 | h3
      · exact h1 (by scalar_tac)
      · exact h2 (by scalar_tac)

/-- Local copy of (the first two conjuncts of) `sub_spec`. -/
theorem mr_sub_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L) :
    sub a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r + Scalar52_as_Nat b =
        Scalar52_as_Nat a + (if Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
  have hz : ∀ j, j < 5 → (ZERO.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
    intro j _; rw [ZERO_val_getElem!]; simp
  progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨d, _, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩
  progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
  progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
  have hi1v : i1.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi1, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hi2v : i2.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by
    rw [← hi1v, hi2, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; simp; omega
  progress with mr_choice_from_spec as ⟨c, hc⟩
  progress with mr_cal_spec as ⟨res, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
  have hcond : (c.val = 1#u8) ↔ d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 := by
    rw [hc]; constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hi2v, h]; rfl
    · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; rw [hi2v, h]; rfl
  have hD := mr_as_Nat_lt d.1 hd2
  have hR := mr_as_Nat_lt res.2 hr1
  have hloop : (Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * ((d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
    rw [← mr_Ico_sum_sub, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq d.1]
    simpa using hd4
  have hadd : Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (res.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 + (if d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 then _root_.L else 0) := by
    rw [hr3]; simp only [hcond]
  exact ⟨hr1, mr_sub_final_arith _ _ _ _ _ _ hd3 hD hR hab hloop hadd⟩

  progress as ⟨ i7, hi7 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi7
  rw [constants.L_limbs.1, ← hL0]
  refine ⟨hplt, hpv, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
  · rw [hi7, hi6, hi5]
    exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hdiv)

/-- Carry split: `part2 sum` returns the carry `sum / 2^52` and the low 52-bit limb
`sum % 2^52`. -/
@[progress]
theorem part2_spec (sum : U128) :
    part2 sum ⦃ r =>
      r.2.val < 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.2.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val = sum.val / 2 ^ 52 ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 76 ∧
      r.1.val * 2 ^ 52 + r.2.val = sum.val ⦄ := by
  unfold part2
  progress as ⟨ i, hi ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i1, hi1 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i2, hi2 ⟩
  progress as ⟨ w, hw ⟩
  progress as ⟨ i3, hi3 ⟩
  simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] at hi3
  have hi2v : i2.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hi2, hi1]; simp only [U64.size, U64.numBits, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; norm_num
  have hwv : w.val = sum.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
    rw [hw, UScalar.val_and, hi2v, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod, hi, UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits,
      show UScalar.size UScalarTy.U64 = 2 ^ 64 by simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]]
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (by norm_num : 2 ^ 52 ∣ 2 ^ 64)]
  have hs : sum.val < 2 ^ 128 := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨?_, hwv, hi3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)
  · rw [hi3]; omega
  · rw [hi3, hwv]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' _ _

end curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce

/-! ## Local specification of `sub`

`Sub.lean` (via `ConditionalAddL.lean`) imports this module, so the specifications of `sub`
and `conditional_add_l` are re-established here under `mr_`-prefixed names. -/

set_option exponentiation.threshold 260

attribute [-simp] Int.reducePow Nat.reducePow

namespace curve25519_dalek.backend.serial.u64.scalar.Scalar52.montgomery_reduce

theorem mr_sub_loop_step_arith (x y w : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 52) (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ 52)
    (hw : w = (x + (2 ^ 64 - y)) % 2 ^ 64) :
    w / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧ ((w % 2 ^ 52 : Nat) : Int) = (x : Int) - y + 2 ^ 52 * ((w / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
  have h64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have h63 : (2 : Nat) ^ 63 = 9223372036854775808 := by norm_num
  have h52 : (2 : Nat) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  have h52' : (2 : Int) ^ 52 = 4503599627370496 := by norm_num
  rw [h64] at hw
  rw [h52] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [h63, h52']
  by_cases hxy : y ≤ x
  · have hw' : w = x - y := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 = w := by omega
    rw [h1, h2, hw']
    constructor
    · omega
    · push_cast [hxy]; ring
  · have hw' : w + y = 18446744073709551616 + x := by omega
    have h1 : w / 9223372036854775808 = 1 := by omega
    have h2 : w % 4503599627370496 + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by omega
    rw [h1]
    constructor
    · omega
    · have h3 : ((w % 4503599627370496 : Nat) : Int) + y = 4503599627370496 + x := by
        exact_mod_cast h2
      push_cast; linarith

theorem mr_sub_loop_post (a b r : Array U64 5#usize) (i : Nat) (f0 f1 F : Int) (hi : i < 5)
    (hri : ((r.val[i]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i]!).val - ((b.val[i]!).val + f0) + 2 ^ 52 * f1)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * f1) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val - 2 ^ 260 * F =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
        2 ^ (52 * i) * f0 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hp : (2 : Int) ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize (2 : Int) ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  linear_combination hrec

/-- Local copy of `sub_loop_spec`. -/
theorem mr_sub_loop_spec (a b difference : Scalar52) (mask borrow : U64) (i : Usize)
    (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hd : ∀ j, j < 5 → (difference.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    sub_loop a b difference mask borrow i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.1.val[j]! = difference.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.1.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 ≤ 1 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (r.1.val[j]!).val -
          2 ^ 260 * ((r.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) *
          (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) -
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨i1, hi1, hi1'⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2, hi2'⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3⟩
    have hi3v : i3.val = borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi3, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi3lt : i3.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi3v]; scalar_tac
    have hai : i1.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi1']; exact ha i.val hilt
    have hbi : i2.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi2']; exact hb i.val hilt
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨w, hw⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hwv : w.val = (i1.val + (2 ^ 64 - i4.val)) % 2 ^ 64 := by
      rw [hw]; simp [U64.size, U64.numBits]
    obtain ⟨hwlt, hwmod⟩ := mr_sub_loop_step_arith i1.val i4.val w.val hai (by omega) hwv
    have hi5v : i5.val = w.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = difference.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hd j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : ((r.1.val[i.val]!).val : Int) = (a.val[i.val]!).val -
          ((b.val[i.val]!).val + ((borrow.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int)) +
          2 ^ 52 * ((w.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v, hwmod, hi4, ← hi1', ← hi2', hi3v]
        push_cast; ring
      exact mr_sub_loop_post a b r.1 i.val _ _ _ hilt hri hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hd, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_select_spec (a b : U64) (choice : subtle.Choice) :
    U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select a b choice ⦃ res =>
      res = if choice.val = 1#u8 then b else a ⦄ := by
  unfold U64.Insts.SubtleConditionallySelectable.conditional_select
  split <;> simp_all

theorem mr_Ico_sum_eq (a : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (a.val[j]!).val = Scalar52_as_Nat a := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

theorem mr_cal_loop_post (self s1 r : Array U64 5#usize) (Lc : Nat → Nat)
    (i A x c' : Nat) (hi : i < 5)
    (hx : x = A + (self.val[i]!).val + Lc i)
    (hri : (r.val[i]!).val = x % 2 ^ 52)
    (hs1 : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s1.val[j]! = self.val[j]!)
    (hrec : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) * (x / 2 ^ 52)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * c' =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) +
        2 ^ (52 * i) * A := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hi]
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((s1.val[j]!).val + Lc j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (i + 1) 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val + Lc j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [hs1 j (by simp at hj; omega)]
  rw [hs] at hrec
  have hsplit := Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ 52)
  have hp : 2 ^ (52 * (i + 1)) = 2 ^ (52 * i) * 2 ^ 52 := by ring
  rw [hp] at hrec
  rw [hri]
  generalize 2 ^ (52 * i) = P at *
  generalize x % 2 ^ 52 = z at *
  generalize x / 2 ^ 52 = y at *
  subst hx
  zify at *
  linear_combination hrec + P * hsplit

/-- Local copy of `conditional_add_l_loop_spec`. -/
theorem mr_cal_loop_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (carry mask : U64) (i : Usize) (hmask : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1) (hi : i.val ≤ 5)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) (hcarry : carry.val < 2 ^ 53) :
    conditional_add_l_loop self condition carry mask i ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < i.val → r.2.val[j]! = self.val[j]!) ∧
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * (r.2.val[j]!).val + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico i.val 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
          (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) +
          2 ^ (52 * i.val) * (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l_loop
  split
  · have hilt : i.val < 5 := by scalar_tac
    progress as ⟨li, hli, hli'⟩
    progress with mr_select_spec as ⟨addend, haddend⟩
    progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
    progress as ⟨i3, hi3, hi3'⟩
    have hLi : li.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hli']; simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using constants.L_bounds i.val hilt
    have hadd : addend.val = (if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[i.val]!).val else 0) := by
      rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hadd_lt : addend.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [haddend]; split <;> simp_all
    have hselfi : i3.val < 2 ^ 52 := by rw [hi3']; exact hself i.val hilt
    have hi2v : i2.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 := by simp [hi2, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    have hi2lt : i2.val ≤ 1 := by rw [hi2v]; omega
    progress as ⟨i4, hi4⟩
    progress as ⟨carry1, hc1⟩
    progress as ⟨old, back, hold, hback, hback1, hback2, hback3⟩
    progress as ⟨i5, hi5⟩
    progress as ⟨i6, hi6⟩
    have hc1v : carry1.val = carry.val / 2 ^ 52 + (self.val[i.val]!).val + addend.val := by
      rw [hc1, hi4, hi2v, hi3']
    have hc1lt : carry1.val < 2 ^ 53 := by omega
    have hi5v : i5.val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
      rw [hi5, UScalar.val_and, hmask, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
    have hs1i : ((back i5).val[i.val]!) = i5 := hback2 i5
    have hs1ne : ∀ j, j ≠ i.val → (back i5).val[j]! = self.val[j]! := hback3 i5
    have hs1b : ∀ j, j < 5 → ((back i5).val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i.val
      · subst hji; rw [hs1i, hi5v]; omega
      · rw [hs1ne j hji]; exact hself j hj
    have hdec : 5 - i6.val < 5 - i.val := by omega
    progress with mr_cal_loop_spec as ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
    · rw [hr1 j (by omega), hs1ne j (by omega)]
    · rw [hi6] at hr4
      have hri : (r.2.val[i.val]!).val = carry1.val % 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [hr1 i.val (by omega), hs1i, hi5v]
      exact mr_cal_loop_post self (back i5) r.2
        (fun j => if condition.val = 1#u8 then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)
        i.val (carry.val / 2 ^ 52) carry1.val (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) hilt
        (by rw [hc1v, hadd]) hri hs1ne hr4
  · have hi5 : i.val = 5 := by scalar_tac
    rw [spec_ok]
    refine ⟨fun j _ => rfl, hself, hcarry, ?_⟩
    simp [hi5]
termination_by 5 - i.val
decreasing_by
  all_goals scalar_tac

theorem mr_cal_sum_split (self : Scalar52) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, 2 ^ (52 * j) * ((self.val[j]!).val +
      (if b then (constants.L.val[j]!).val else 0)) =
      Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if b then _root_.L else 0) := by
  rw [← mr_Ico_sum_eq self]
  cases b
  · simp
  · simp only [if_true, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mr_Ico_sum_eq,
      constants.L_spec]

/-- Local copy of `conditional_add_l_spec`. -/
theorem mr_cal_spec (self : Scalar52) (condition : subtle.Choice)
    (hself : ∀ j, j < 5 → (self.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    conditional_add_l self condition ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.2.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      r.1.val < 2 ^ 53 ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (r.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
        Scalar52_as_Nat self + (if condition.val = 1#u8 then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold conditional_add_l
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by norm_num)]
  progress with mr_cal_loop_spec as ⟨r, _, hr2, hr3, hr4⟩
  refine ⟨hr2, hr3, ?_⟩
  have h := mr_cal_sum_split self (decide (condition.val = 1#u8))
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rw [← h, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq r.2]
  simpa using hr4

theorem mr_as_Nat_lt (a : Scalar52) (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) :
    Scalar52_as_Nat a < 2 ^ 260 := by
  have h0 := ha 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := ha 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := ha 2 (by omega)
  have h3 := ha 3 (by omega)
  have h4 := ha 4 (by omega)
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq]
  norm_num at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  omega

theorem mr_Ico_sum_sub (a b : Scalar52) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 0 5, (2 : Int) ^ (52 * j) * (((a.val[j]!).val : Int) - (b.val[j]!).val) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
  unfold Scalar52_as_Nat
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Array.getElem!_Nat_eq,
    Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.zero_le _), Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem mr_sub_final_arith (A B D R f q : Nat) (hf : f ≤ 1) (hD : D < 2 ^ 260) (hR : R < 2 ^ 260)
    (hBA : B ≤ A + _root_.L)
    (hloop : (D : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * f = (A : Int) - B)
    (hadd : R + 2 ^ 260 * q = D + (if f = 1 then _root_.L else 0)) :
    R + B = A + (if A < B then _root_.L else 0) := by
  have hL : _root_.L < 2 ^ 260 := by unfold _root_.L; norm_num
  have h260 : (2 : Nat) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  have h260' : (2 : Int) ^ 260 = 1852673427797059126777135760139006525652319754650249024631321344126610074238976 := by norm_num
  rw [h260'] at hloop
  rw [h260] at hD hR hadd hL
  generalize _root_.L = L at *
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hf with rfl | rfl
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : ¬ A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_false]
    omega
  · simp at hadd
    have hAB : A < B := by omega
    simp only [hAB, if_true]
    omega

theorem mr_choice_from_spec (x : U8) (h : x.val ≤ 1) :
    subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from x ⦃ c => c.val = x ⦄ := by
  unfold subtle.Choice.Insts.CoreConvertFromU8.from
  split
  · simp
  · split
    · simp
    · exfalso
      rename_i h1 h2
      have : x.val = 0 ∨ x.val = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h3 | h3
      · exact h1 (by scalar_tac)
      · exact h2 (by scalar_tac)

/-- Local copy of (the first two conjuncts of) `sub_spec`. -/
theorem mr_sub_spec (a b : Scalar52)
    (ha : ∀ j, j < 5 → (a.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hb : ∀ j, j < 5 → (b.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52)
    (hab : Scalar52_as_Nat b ≤ Scalar52_as_Nat a + _root_.L) :
    sub a b ⦃ r =>
      (∀ j, j < 5 → (r.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52) ∧
      Scalar52_as_Nat r + Scalar52_as_Nat b =
        Scalar52_as_Nat a + (if Scalar52_as_Nat a < Scalar52_as_Nat b then _root_.L else 0) ⦄ := by
  unfold sub
  progress as ⟨i, hi⟩
  progress as ⟨mask, hmask⟩
  have hmv : mask.val = 2 ^ 52 - 1 := by
    rw [hmask, hi]; simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, U64.size, U64.numBits]
  have hz : ∀ j, j < 5 → (ZERO.val[j]!).val < 2 ^ 52 := by
    intro j _; rw [ZERO_val_getElem!]; simp
  progress with mr_sub_loop_spec as ⟨d, _, hd2, hd3, hd4⟩
  progress as ⟨i1, hi1⟩
  progress as ⟨i2, hi2⟩
  have hi1v : i1.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by simp [hi1, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hi2v : i2.val = d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 := by
    rw [← hi1v, hi2, UScalar.cast_val_eq]; simp; omega
  progress with mr_choice_from_spec as ⟨c, hc⟩
  progress with mr_cal_spec as ⟨res, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
  have hcond : (c.val = 1#u8) ↔ d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 = 1 := by
    rw [hc]; constructor
    · intro h; rw [← hi2v, h]; rfl
    · intro h; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; rw [hi2v, h]; rfl
  have hD := mr_as_Nat_lt d.1 hd2
  have hR := mr_as_Nat_lt res.2 hr1
  have hloop : (Scalar52_as_Nat d.1 : Int) - 2 ^ 260 * ((d.2.val / 2 ^ 63 : Nat) : Int) =
      (Scalar52_as_Nat a : Int) - Scalar52_as_Nat b := by
    rw [← mr_Ico_sum_sub, ← mr_Ico_sum_eq d.1]
    simpa using hd4
  have hadd : Scalar52_as_Nat res.2 + 2 ^ 260 * (res.1.val / 2 ^ 52) =
